ready_scope: Official source snapshot, data archives, paper protocol, bpRNA-new I/O contract and fail-closed GPU launcher
blocked_scope: No official local implementation, checkpoint/weights, checkpoint SHA, model/weight license, official batch CLI, or author-released bpRNA-new 5388 predictions

TestSet_alpha.zip.scope: official test archive; audited only, never used for tuning

TestSet_beta.zip.scope: official test archive; audited only, never used for tuning

TestSet_gamma.zip.scope: official test archive; audited only, never used for tuning

paper.title: DEBFold: Computational Identification of RNA Secondary Structures for Sequences across Structural Families Using Deep Learning

training_protocol.input: l x 10: l x 4 RNA one-hot plus six l x 1 paired-location tracks from RNAfold, IPknot, MaxExpect, ProbKnot, RNAprob and Fold
training_protocol.stage1_output: l folding probabilities Y; SHAPE-like score S=1-Y
training_protocol.stage2: RNAstructure Fold MFE with SHAPE-like soft constraints; default slope/intercept
training_protocol.length_protocol: Methods: no prediction padding and <512 nt suggested; Limitations: current version suitable only for sequences up to 512 bps
training_protocol.loss: sum of per-base binary cross-entropy; positive weight 1.8
training_protocol.learning_rate: cosine decay to 1e-13 for epochs 1-227, then exponential decay with multiplicative factor 1e-10 for 23 epochs

dataset_protocol.training_validation: bpRNA-1m/Rfam12.2; 43269 valid sequences/2125 families; reserve 44 families; 2081 training-validation families; at most 5 sequences/family; 8782 structures
dataset_protocol.test_alpha: 44 sequences, one per reserved family; CD-HIT 0.85 separation
dataset_protocol.test_beta: bpRNA-new/Rfam14.4 excluding Rfam12.2; 481 families/5265 sequences eligible, then 4 families from each of 10 length bins = 40 sequences; CD-HIT 0.85 separation
dataset_protocol.test_gamma: PDB-derived; 147 eligible before length balancing; 15 sequences; excludes >85% similarity to DEBFold training-validation and SPOT-RNA TR1

bprna_new_5388_contract.input: JSONL name/seq; project reference pairs retained only for later evaluation, never official-model tuning
bprna_new_5388_contract.output: One JSONL row per input: {name,seq,pred_pairs}; zero-based inclusive i<j; complete 5388-name/sequence identity required

gpu_execution.reason: Official implementation/weights absent and occupied GPU must not be disturbed

provenance_policy: No unrelated same-name repository, paper-derived reimplementation, pseudo-weights, summary-only score, reference labels, or zero scores substituted
